sources.//: PLACEHOLDER PIN. `commit` is the current master HEAD and is real, but no release tag exists in the repository yet, so no tag/commit pair could be resolved. At release time replace `commit` with the tagged release commit and add "tag": "vX.Y.Z" pointing at that same commit (Flathub requires a tag for release builds). A `type: git` source is pinned by its commit SHA, which is content-addressed; if you prefer a tarball + sha256 instead, replace this whole object with {"type": "archive", "url": "https://github.com/vindeckyy/CastMirror/archive/refs/tags/vX.Y.Z.tar.gz", "sha256": "<sha256 of that tarball>"}.
